submission.bindingBasis: Planning evidence pinned workspace head 4e6ce6372517d821336b75ccd1f43c90c983d59a and sourceStateDigest sha256:e5d8008d22495e6f0f4e5c66c0ffe9377b031ca7c3970d2391e8076a3e62ce64; the boundary evidence reports the owner changed and workspace source identity advanced after planning, so the exact expectedSourceStateDigest from planning may no longer match. A compare-and-close with the stale digest would fail not_committed, and an unbound close would risk closing a workspace whose state was not the one reviewed at planning time.
submission.rationale: The owner boundary reports source identity advanced after planning. Closing with the planning-time digest risks a not_committed failure (if binding strictly) or closing an un-reviewed newer state (if unbound). Since the intended consequence is to close the workspace and release its local materialization, we should first re-observe the workspace's current head and sourceStateDigest to decide whether close is still safe and appropriate, rather than acting on stale planning evidence.
